clue.text: Female player, one to be taken into account

definitions.text: one to be taken into account

parts.note: an actor is a player on the stage

explanation.surface: A woman performer who must be reckoned with.
explanation.definitionFit: A factor is an element or consideration that has to be weighed when judging a situation.

clue.text: In reality, records are set up in surgery

indicators.note: In says one piece goes inside another

parts.note: a fact is a reality

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a file is a set of records

explanation.surface: Papers are actually prepared in a hospital theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' reverses the word for records, as a down entry reads upwards; 'In reality' looks like a phrase but 'In' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A facelift is cosmetic surgery to tighten the skin of the face.

clue.text: Noisy group of people in vineyard

indicators.note: Noisy says the word is heard, a soundalike

parts.note: a crew is a group of people working together

explanation.surface: A rowdy gang turns up among the vines.
explanation.walkthrough: CRU, French for a vineyard or wine growth, sounds like CREW.
explanation.definitionFit: A cru is a vineyard or the wine it produces, as in grand cru.

clue.text: He ignores the truth: torch is broken

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to face facts after their torch breaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' rearranges TORCH IS.
explanation.definitionFit: An ostrich is a person who buries their head in the sand, refusing to face facts.

clue.text: A set of tools (carpenter's tools) about to produce a cross of sorts

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the whole string of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: a kit is a set of tools
saws are tools a carpenter uses

explanation.surface: A woodworker's tool kit somehow ends up making a cross.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' reverses the whole run A KIT SAWS, giving SWAS TIKA.
explanation.definitionFit: The swastika is a hooked cross, an ancient symbol later adopted by the Nazis.

clue.text: Head supporting those who punish a scallywag

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece below supports the one above

parts.note: whippers are people who punish by whipping
napper is British slang for the head

explanation.surface: A head teacher backs the disciplinarians against a rascal.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'supporting' puts NAPPER below WHIPPERS.
explanation.definitionFit: A whippersnapper is a cheeky, presumptuous young person, a scallywag.

clue.text: Essayist keeping quiet inside part of church

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it, so a letter goes into the word
inside confirms the letter is placed within the name

parts.note: Richard Steele was an essayist who founded The Tatler
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A writer stays silent within a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' ... 'inside' puts P inside STEELE.
explanation.definitionFit: A steeple is a church's tower with its spire.

clue.text: Under canvas, so to speak, I have become distracted

indicators.note: so to speak says the phrase is said out loud and spelt as heard

parts.note: camping under canvas is being in a tent
I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: A camper admits to losing focus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so to speak' signals a soundalike: camping 'in a tent', said aloud, is spelt as heard. 'become' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Being inattentive means not paying attention, which is what distracted means.

clue.text: Yes, it's a sin

parts.note: greed is one of the seven deadly sins

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to a moral failing.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'Agreed!' is a way of saying yes to a proposal.

clue.text: Moreover, two books may be paid for thus

definitions.meaning: in addition, for the same reason

definitions.text: two books may be paid for thus
definitions.meaning: a playful reading: each book paid for with an identical book token

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means 'for the same reason' or 'also'; read literally it means using matching gift vouchers.

clue.text: Coast-to coast, moving west to south, into rural area

indicators.note: this phrase says the letter for west is changed to the letter for south

parts.note: something spread coast to coast is countrywide

explanation.surface: Someone travelling across the land, heading west then south, ends up in the sticks.
explanation.walkthrough: W (west) in COUNTRYWIDE becomes S (south). The page prints 'Coast-to-coast'.
explanation.definitionFit: The countryside is land outside towns and cities, a rural region.

clue.text: Broadcast tune

definitions.meaning: to broadcast a programme is to put it on ..., used as a verb
a melody, as in a familiar ...

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to transmit on radio or TV; as a noun it means a melody.

clue.text: Macho stable-worker, a smasher

parts.note: a stable lad looks after racehorses
a smasher, or a dish, is a very attractive person

explanation.surface: A tough stable hand who is also a looker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a smasher' is British slang for a good-looking person, as is 'a dish'.
explanation.definitionFit: Laddish behaviour is brash and boisterously masculine, much like macho.

clue.text: Approach with arrows — they communicate power

parts.note: a drive is the approach road up to a house
shafts are arrows

explanation.surface: An archer advances on the target with arrows ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Drive shafts are rotating rods that transmit power from an engine to the wheels.

clue.text: Some pup I petted in the tube

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a dog I stroked has ended up in a tube.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'in the tube' as the definition, but a noun cannot be replaced by a prepositional phrase; 'in the' is the link and 'tube' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipette is a slender glass tube used to measure or transfer small amounts of liquid.

clue.text: NCO's fine, delicate fabric given to soldier

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', so the definition reads as NCO

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil grades
light means delicate or not heavy
serge is a hard-wearing twilled cloth
a soldier ant is a kind of worker insect, so ant is a crossword soldier

explanation.surface: A non-commissioned officer is described: a fine, delicate fabric handed to a soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'NCO's' reads as 'NCO is'. A flight sergeant is an RAF NCO rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight sergeant is a non-commissioned officer rank in the Royal Air Force.

clue.text: Loss of appetite, extremely rare in case of oxygen deficiency

indicators.note: something put in the case of another is enclosed by it

parts.note: anoxia is a lack of oxygen in the body

indicators.note: extremely means the extremes, the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A medical note: poor appetite is very rare where oxygen is lacking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' gives R and E from rare; 'in case of' puts them inside ANOXIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Anorexia is a medical term for a lack of appetite, besides the eating disorder.

clue.text: Entire commando in mess for testimonial

indicators.note: in a mess means jumbled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The whole commando unit is in the mess hall, awaiting a reference.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in mess' rearranges the letters of ENTIRE COMMANDO.
explanation.definitionFit: A testimonial is a written recommendation of someone's character or ability.

clue.text: Aid once distributed by nymph

indicators.note: distributed means spread around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Charity aid was handed out by a sea spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distributed' rearranges AID ONCE.
explanation.definitionFit: An oceanid is a sea nymph of Greek myth, a daughter of Oceanus.

clue.text: Labour are left without leaders of international standing

parts.note: an are is a metric unit of area, A

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so a word goes around the rest

parts.note: gone means left, departed

indicators.note: leaders means the first letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A political report: the Labour Party has lost its leading international figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' reads as the party but is the verb. 'leaders of' gives I and S, which GONE goes around ('without').
explanation.definitionFit: To agonise is to struggle or labour over something.

clue.text: Rescuer ignoring one suggestion

indicators.note: ignoring something leaves it out

parts.note: a saviour is one who rescues
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A lifeguard brushes off a proposal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring' drops I from SAVIOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A savour can mean a hint or trace of something, a suggestion of it.

clue.text: Most grey pitches are surrounded by edges of asphalt

indicators.note: something surrounded by a frame sits inside it, so a word goes inside
edges means the outer letters, the first and last of the word

parts.note: to shy is to throw, so pitches can mean shies

explanation.surface: Grey football pitches ringed by asphalt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'edges of' gives A and T, the first and last letters of asphalt; 'surrounded by' puts SHIES between them. The held text has a stray S the page does not print.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashy means ash-coloured or pale grey, so the superlative is the greyest.

clue.text: In post, I break new ground

indicators.note: In tells us one piece sits inside another

parts.note: a pier is a pillar or supporting post
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A postal worker boasts of being an innovator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'post' suggests mail, but here it is a pillar.
explanation.definitionFit: To pioneer is to be first to develop something, breaking new ground.

clue.text: Sort of a Yahoo

indicators.note: to sort letters is to rearrange them, so the following words are reordered

explanation.surface: Something resembling a boorish lout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort' rearranges OF A. A Yahoo is one of the brutish humans in Gulliver's Travels.
explanation.definitionFit: A yahoo is a coarse, loutish person, much as a clumsy oaf is.

clue.text: One keen kid in moving vote for Japanese values

indicators.note: moving letters around means rearranging them

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a cross, X, marks a vote on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic child takes part in a shifting vote about Japanese prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges I + KEENKIDIN; X follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nikkei index measures share values on the Tokyo stock exchange.

clue.text: Do you change colour?

definitions.meaning: an old or dialect contraction of the question words 'do you'
to tint fabric or hair a new shade

explanation.definitionFit: Spelt without the apostrophe, the contraction of 'do you' gives the word for tinting something a new colour.

clue.text: Lodger, and what it costs him to hold party

indicators.note: one piece holds another, so it goes inside

parts.note: a lodger pays rent for his room
a side is a party in a dispute or contest

explanation.surface: A lodger's rent goes up when he hosts a party.
explanation.walkthrough: RENT holds SIDE: RE-SIDE-NT.
explanation.definitionFit: A resident is someone living in a place, as a lodger lives in a house.

clue.text: WHO is here, and could be forced to avenge

indicators.note: letters forced out of place are rearranged

explanation.surface: The World Health Organization could be pushed into taking revenge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be forced' rearranges AVENGE. WHO is the World Health Organization.
explanation.definitionFit: The World Health Organization has its headquarters in the Swiss city.
